notes.objective: Reduction-only control: Ltype_mean + (lambda1*intra_sum + lambda2*(inter_info_sum + .1*margin) + lambda3*masked_recon_sum)/M, M actual type denominator. Preserve sum-C EN weights; NOT literal Eq34 normalization or exact paper reproduction.
notes.targets: mi_target = mi_v2[:, :n_mi] train functional similarity; dis_target = dis_v2[:, :n_dis] MeSH semantic similarity; coverage = train-mask support (miRNA) and declared descriptor_audit complement (disease), diagonals always excluded; built by accepted reconstruction_targets builder from explicit --meta/--audit sidecars only
notes.embeddings: c4_model.PaperGuidedC4 = PaperGuidedC2 ctor + ReconstructionAdapter registered after; heads consume raw fused pre-HGT zm_pre/zd_pre of the SAME forward; adapter uses accepted seed+4001 fork_rng factory so baseline params and global RNG are byte-identical; optimizer built AFTER registration so all four decoder weights participate
notes.disabled: lam_recon==0 -> adapter heads=None: no sidecar read, no target build, no head init/parameters; preserves C3 weights, RNG and numeric trajectory bitwise; lam_intra/lam_inter/lam_recon all zero -> S1 bitwise
notes.negatives: inter bank unchanged: A_train-zero cells, seeded generator seed=inter_seed, cap=min(available,10*n_pos_i), ASSUMED negatives; held-out labels never read
notes.fallbacks: inter margin .5 / coef .1 are declared official-code fallbacks; recon reduction and hidden/proj head widths are declared engineering choices
notes.all_else: Identical C4 model/objectives/targets/bank/features and optimizer; no presence/existence objective
notes.pilot: One slot6/6 instead of conditional/unimplemented presence C6; same fold0seed1234/max200/eval10/Adam1e-4/wd1e-5/two threads/validation macro-F1. No parameter search.
notes.dynamic: Fixed5 epoch refresh after optimizer, pre-eval; cached raw Grams from same pre-optimizer forward; accepted D1 offdiag-minmax/binary-HGT/direct-KNN/modality-shared-topology engineering choices; no performance-based tuning.
notes.u1x: U1 objective unchanged; + lam_exist*focal existence on mask cells + pinned 10x mask-zero subsample; sanity fold0 only, not a result

neg_bank.provenance: A_train-zero cells, ASSUMED negatives (not verified); local seeded generator, no held-out label access; allocated even at lam_inter==0 (numerically inert)

recon.mi_target_id: mi_v2[:, :n_mi] train functional similarity (S_func, train-mask built)
recon.diagonal_policy: always excluded (fixed to 1.0 in feature preparation)
recon.reduction: global valid-cell weighted mean (masked_sum_mi+masked_sum_dis)/(valid_count_mi+valid_count_dis) — declared engineering unit, not literal Frobenius-sum

exist_supervision.sampling: one-time default_rng(seed+77) subsample of train-mask-zero cells, min(10x n_pos, avail) — port of upstream single torch.randperm subsample; ASSUMED negatives, held-out positives included (same semantics as upstream zero_index)
